card.name: The m in Technetium Tc 99m
card.fires_on: The letter m right after "Technetium Tc 99" in radiopharmaceutical names, just before the kit or agent name (pentetate, Succimer, Sestamibi). It also fires weakly on the end of a few drug names such as hydrobromide and sofosbuvir.
